quicklinks.story.title: This year's story

why.heading: Why come
why.meeting.title: Reunion
why.meeting.desc: Because we meet here again. Old friends, new faces and the people you only ever see at this one weekend each year.
why.tradition.title: Tradition
why.tradition.desc: Since 1992 the event has changed, grown and been passed on. Coming here means joining something we've been building together for many years.
why.atmosphere.title: Atmosphere
why.atmosphere.desc: A few days in a Middle-earth we build together — out of camps, costumes, fires, stories, the landscape and the small moments between people.
why.battles.title: The battle
why.battles.desc: The Saturday battle is the peak of the weekend, but not the only reason to come. It's a shared experience that stays with you long after.
why.community.title: Camps and sides
why.community.desc: Each side has its own rhythm, customs, faces and mood. Whether it's your first event or your tenth, there's always somewhere you belong.
why.costumes.title: Costumes and craft
why.costumes.desc: Costumes, armour, weapons, banners and the small details aren't just scenery. They're things people pour their time, their hands and a piece of themselves into.
factions.heading: Armies and sides
factions.subheading: From the riders of Rohan to the corsairs of Umbar — the Free Peoples and the forces of the Dark Lord come alive again each year in one shared story.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheading: The most common questions before the event
faq.q1: Is the event suitable for newcomers?
faq.a1: Yes — we run a programme for complete newcomers including intro workshops, rule briefings and the option to join one of the bigger groups.
faq.q2: What do I need for a costume?
faq.a2: A basic costume must match the Middle-earth theme of your chosen army. Specific requirements are in the Armies section of your side. If you don’t have a costume yet, see the Newcomers section.
faq.a3: Registration runs online via Registračka.cz. After filling in the form you’ll get confirmation and payment instructions. Payment must be made within 10 days.
faq.a4: A medic is always present at the event. Combat rules are designed to minimise injury risk. If anything happens, find the nearest organiser.
faq.q5: How much does the event cost?
faq.a5: The fee depends on the date of registration. The current price is in the Registration section.
faq.q6: Can I bring my own weapon?
faq.a6: Only LARP-safe weapons that pass the safety check. Sharp, metal or unsafely hard weapons are not allowed.

event_facts.heading: Akce v kostce
event_facts.intro: Pán Prstenů 2026 probíhá od čtvrtka 20. 8. až do neděle 23. 8. 2026 na louce a v lese mezi městysem Křtiny a obcí Bukovina (Jižní Morava). Hlavní hra probíhá v sobotu, ale i v pátek chystáme táborový program, dětskou hru, jarmark, arény a další aktivity.
event_facts.note: Hlavní hra probíhá v sobotu. Pátek patří táborovému programu, dětské hře, jarmarku, arénám a přípravě. Neděle je vyhrazena pro balení a odjezd.

reg.login.box.intro_p1: To sign up for the event you need an account on the registration system Registračka.cz.

reg.login.box.intro_p4: 2) You have never used Registračka before, so you don't have an account yet. Choose new registration. It will guide you through the whole process. After completion you'll receive a confirmation email with a link. The registration is only finalised after clicking that link.
reg.login.box.intro_p5: 3) You may have used the system before but aren't sure. In that case, try password reset first. If your e-mail is in the system, you'll receive an info e-mail and can sign in normally — see step (1).
